title: Mobile phone with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x='25' y='8' width='50' height='84' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#3a86ff'/>
  <!-- lighter inner edge to show shape -->
  <rect x='29' y='12' width='42' height='76' rx='7' ry='7' fill='#5fa8ff'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='33' y='20' width='34' height='52' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- screen glow edge -->
  <rect x='33' y='20' width='34' height='52' rx='4' ry='4' fill='none' stroke='#4a90d9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='38.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='38.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M41 51 Q50 61 59 51' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='49' r='3' fill='#ff6b9d' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='49' r='3' fill='#ff6b9d' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- home button at bottom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='6' fill='#2a6fd6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='3.5' fill='#7bbdff'/>
  <!-- speaker at top -->
  <rect x='44' y='14' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2a6fd6'/>
  <!-- side buttons -->
  <rect x='23' y='30' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#2a6fd6'/>
  <rect x='74' y='30' width='3' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#2a6fd6'/>
</svg>
